standard_prerequisites.name: Invertibility of the strict transform of the dualizing module
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Divisors, the lemma producing a blowup with respect to the Fitting ideal such that the strict transform of a given coherent module is invertible
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the blowup over which the strict transform of the dualizing module is an invertible sheaf.

standard_prerequisites.name: Domination by normalized blowups and normality of the blowups
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, the lemma dominating a proper birational morphism by normalized blowups at closed points, and the lemma that the blowup of the maximal ideal of a normal rational surface singularity is normal
standard_prerequisites.use: Supply the sequence of normalized blowups dominating the chosen blowup together with the fact that each step is an ordinary blowup and every term is normal.

standard_prerequisites.name: Dualizing modules of regular and of blown up rational singularities, and injectivity of the comparison map
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Dualizing Complexes, the lemma that a regular scheme is Gorenstein, and Same chapter, the lemmas describing the dualizing module of the blowup and the surjectivity of the comparison map along such a blowup
standard_prerequisites.use: Supply the invertibility at regular points and the surjectivity on stalks along the sequence at singular points.

standard_prerequisites.name: Torsion freeness of the dualizing module
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Duality for Schemes, the lemma that the dualizing module of a normal scheme is torsion free
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the final identification of the quotient by torsion with the dualizing module of the last term.

core_obligations: Find a blowup making the strict transform invertible (proof lines 2701-2712): the dualizing module is a finite module whose stalk at the generic point is invertible of rank one, so the lemma on strict transforms produces a blowup over which that strict transform is invertible.

Replace it by a sequence of point blowups (proof lines 2712-2718): the domination lemma provides a sequence of normalized blowups at closed points dominating that blowup, and by the normality lemma and induction each step of the sequence is an ordinary blowup of a singular point and every term is normal.

Show invertibility at every point (proof lines 2720-2736): at a regular point invertibility is clear because regular schemes are Gorenstein; at a singular point each of the images of the point in the earlier terms is again singular, so the comparison maps from the pullback of the dualizing module are surjective on stalks by the blowup lemmas and induction; combining this with the choice of the blowup, the quotient of the pullback by its torsion submodule is invertible at that point, and since the dualizing module is torsion free it agrees there with the dualizing module of the last term, which is therefore invertible.
proof_roadmap: Choose a blowup making the strict transform of the dualizing module invertible.
Dominate that blowup by a sequence of normalized blowups at singular closed points, checking normality and that each step is an ordinary blowup.
Check invertibility of the dualizing module at regular and at singular points and conclude by torsion freeness.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a two dimensional local normal Nagata domain defining a rational singularity and admitting a dualizing complex there is a finite sequence of blowups in singular closed points with all terms normal such that the dualizing sheaf of the last term is invertible (statement lines 2687-2699). The proof (proof lines 2701-2743) produces a blowup making the strict transform of the dualizing module invertible, dominates it by normalized blowups, checks invertibility at regular and singular points through the comparison maps, and concludes using torsion freeness. H3: a two-stage construction with a pointwise verification, written out in full.
